title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: To bring about the realisation of human rights for poor and marginalised men and women affected by high inequality, human rights violations and violence in seven conflict or post-conflict countries by addressing issues of governance, tackling violence, building peace and promoting equality for all, particularly gender equality. Outcome 1.1: 'Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights’ Bill is drafted and ready for tabling and the consultation process for drafting of ‘Vocational Training’ bill is initiated by relevant ministries. lll Outcome 1.2: Women, men, girls and boys in Rumonge and Makamba have greater access to quality SRHR and family planning services through strengthened and accountable SRH delivery. Objective 1: Marginalised women and men realise their human rights by having more equitable access to land, housing, basic services and secure livelihoods, benefit from progressive taxes and fiscal policies and actively participate as citizens and influence decisions that affect their lives.
